title: Austin's 1903 Storm Sewer Project and Tax Approval
summary:
• **Tax Rolls Approved**: The city council unanimously approved the 1903 tax assessment rolls, allowing tax collection to proceed for the year.

• **Storm Sewer Superintendent Hired**: Council authorized the Mayor and Street Committee to hire a supervisor for constructing a storm water sewer on Congress Avenue at up to $100 per month—a decision that passed after a close 7-5 vote.

• **Close Council Vote**: The superintendent resolution faced notable opposition, with aldermen nearly evenly split, suggesting debate over the project's cost or necessity.
